title: Impact of precursor dosing on the surface passivation of AZO/AlOx stacks formed using atomic layer deposition
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,553-564
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00552J, Paper

Yan Wang, Theodore D. C. Hobson, Jack E. N. Swallow, Shona McNab, John O’Sullivan, Anastasia H. Soeriyadi, Xinya Niu, Rebekah C. Fraser, Akash Dasgupta, Soumyajit Maitra, Pietro P. Altermatt, Robert S. Weatherup, Matthew Wright, Ruy S. Bonilla
Aluminium-doped ZnO deposited by ALD provides transparency, conductivity, and c-Si passivation for high-efficiency solar cells, reducing the need for indium-based TCOs. Precise Zn/Al control enables passivation with J0 < 1 fA cm−2 and 740 mV iVOC.
